name: OS Sandbox — gitignore read-shroud
description: Withholds contents of gitignored/secret-shaped files from Read/Bash tool results before the model reasons on them; file metadata (exists/size/mode/mtime) still passes so a bot can audit posture without reading values. App-layer companion to the egress sandbox (internal:true + egress-proxy). Requires origin:bundled to arm the tool-result middleware seam.

reachRoots.description: Absolute reach roots that are git repos to scan for gitignored paths (e.g. ["/reach/runes"]). The always-shroud globs and secret-dir rules apply everywhere regardless.

enforce.description: true (default): replace shrouded contents. false: audit-only dry-run — record would-shroud events but let contents through (for validating the manifest before arming).

auditPath.description: JSONL audit path for shroud events (default: ~/.openclaw/logs/shroud-audit.jsonl)

rescanIntervalMs.description: TTL in ms for the gitignore manifest cache (default: 60000)
